findings.xrp_reserve_wallet_attribution: Bitquery labels all 17 drained wallets as Binance PoR addresses, including five XRPL source wallets; official Binance address-file crosswalk not yet performed.
findings.xrp_receiver_cutoff: Approximately 233.5M XRP remained at the attacker receiver at 06:43 UTC; no outgoing observed by that cutoff. No later balance claimed.
findings.security_root_cause: Reuters reports Binance found additional breach points; TRM assesses signing infrastructure was compromised. Exact initial access and authorization path remain unknown; private-key exfiltration not established.
findings.recovery_commitment: Binance reported USD 6.34B company resources, including USD 5B in impacted token assets, and USD 3B frozen/protected; XRP-specific replenishment not verified.
findings.por_checkpoint: November 1 monthly snapshot is next checkpoint; Binance's official FAQ says results are released by the seventh.
